# CUDA Rust agent documentation

> CUDA Rust provides SIMT kernels with cuda-oxide, tile kernels with cuTile Rust, and shared host runtime crates. This index points to NVIDIA's documentation at a fixed source revision.

The snapshot is NVIDIA/cuda-rust commit `0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3`, checked on 2026-10-29. CUDA Rust is an early-stage research project and APIs may change. Match documentation and examples to the project's dependency versions. The links below describe the snapshot, not necessarily a released crate. Consult the current documentation when working with another version.

## Start here

- [CUDA Rust overview and model selection](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/blob/0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3/README.md): SIMT, Tile, shared runtime and toolchain comparison.
- [Current CUDA Rust documentation](https://nvidia.github.io/cuda-rust/): current overview and links to the books.
- [NVIDIA CUDA Rust releases](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/releases): releases and version-specific changes.

## cuda-oxide

- [cuda-oxide README](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/blob/0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3/cuda-oxide/README.md): requirements, installation, compiler and examples.
- [cuda-oxide book](https://nvidia.github.io/cuda-rust/cuda-oxide/): current guides for SIMT kernels, safety, launches and debugging.
- [SIMT launch guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/blob/0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3/cuda-oxide/cuda-oxide-book/gpu-programming/launching-kernels.md): launch contracts and kernel invocation at the snapshot.

## cuTile Rust

- [cuTile README](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/blob/0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3/cutile-rs/README.md): requirements, installation and examples.
- [cuTile book](https://nvidia.github.io/cuda-rust/cutile/latest/): current guides and API references.
- [Tensors and tiles](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/blob/0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3/cutile-rs/cutile-book/guide/tensors-and-tiles.md): tensor views, partitions and tiles at the snapshot.
- [Vector addition tutorial](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/blob/0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3/cutile-rs/cutile-book/tutorials/02-vector-addition.md): host and kernel example at the snapshot.

## Shared runtime

- [Host API reference](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/blob/0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3/cutile-rs/cutile-book/reference/host-api.md): host tensors, execution and runtime at the snapshot.
- [Interoperability guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/blob/0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3/cutile-rs/cutile-book/guide/interoperability.md): external memory and stream integration at the snapshot.
- [SIMT and Tile inter-kernel example](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-rust/blob/0d62b682be98a12897867b23ff0dfc0d765e9fa3/cuda-oxide/crates/rustc-codegen-cuda/examples/cutile_inter_kernel/README.md): kernels share device buffers on a stream.
